decision.hypothesis: The candidate's bilateral progressive stiffness is produced collectively by direction-selective engagement of tendon_1 under plus_x loading and tendon_3 under minus_x loading, and a fresh paired replay that disables those two passive limits will both resolve the missing paired-mechanism check and determine whether the intact candidate satisfies every-physics-step qualification and the original evaluator.
decision.expected_observation: In the intact member of the fresh pair, both load directions complete without contact, preserve the recorded displacement and recovery bounds, show stiffness ratio at least 1.5, exhibit low-stage slack and high-stage tension through tendon_1 for plus_x and tendon_3 for minus_x, and pass every-step speed, balance, and length qualifications. Relative to that intact member, disabling tendon_1 and tendon_3 produces the frozen paired-mechanism signature in both directions, including the required high-displacement increase and late-stiffness reduction, so the original evaluator returns a complete result rather than UNKNOWN paired-mechanism values.
decision.weakening_observation: The hypothesis is weakened if disabling tendon_1 and tendon_3 does not materially reduce progressive stiffening or does not satisfy the frozen paired-mechanism contrasts in either direction. The candidate-level acceptance hypothesis is weakened if the intact replay retains low or recovery qualification failures, violates any displacement, recovery, transition, tension, length, or no-contact bound, terminates incompletely, or still lacks a complete evaluator result.
decision.fixed_conditions: Use the exact candidate bd44597274f2f056b4d0cee43b6b050649178f9e2905922637bc3a2404268175 with no design edits and no active control source. Run the registered passive_response_v2 protocol from a fresh unloaded hard equilibrium for plus_x and minus_x, with the frozen 20 s load programs, 0.000125 s timestep, two cells per segment, gravity, mount, solver settings, full-physics recording, every-step route and qualification checks, and all original evaluator thresholds unchanged. The only intervention is disabling the passive limits of tendon_1 and tendon_3 in the ablated member of the fresh paired replay.
decision.stopping_condition: Stop after the single fresh paired replay has completed or terminated and the original evaluator has reported intact-versus-ablated outcomes for both load directions, including every-step qualifications and paired-mechanism status; do not repeat automatically. A complete pass can support a later selection decision, while any failure or incomplete result requires a separate diagnosis rather than being treated as infeasibility.
decision.interpretation: This action tests the collective contribution of the two direction-associated passive tendon limits while simultaneously obtaining the independent full-protocol evidence that is currently missing. A successful paired contrast would support the specified collective engagement mechanism only under the frozen candidate, loads, and protocol; it would not isolate the individual causal effect of either tendon, establish robustness or repeatability, or justify extrapolation beyond the tested conditions. The existing finite sampled contrasts are not treated as gradients or as task acceptance.
